}}'''The Final Match and a Surprising Finale!''' (Japanese: '''決勝！！ 意外な結末！''' ''It's Decided!! An Unexpected Conclusion!'') is the seventh chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
==Major events==
{{spoilers}}
* {{adv|Moon}} and [[Gladion]] continue their battle.
* Moon learns about [[regional form]]s from [[Samson Oak]].
* Gladion defeats Moon and advances to the final round.
* {{adv|Sun}} and Gladion begin their battle against each other.
* A mysterious energy shoots from the [[Ultra Wormhole|crack in the sky]] and hits the [[Sparkling Stone]] on Sun's wrist.
* The energy allows {{adv|Dollar}} to fire a [[Z-Move|powerful]] {{m|Inferno Overdrive|attack}} that defeats Gladion's {{TP|Gladion|Type: Null}}.
* Sun passes out from exhaustion.
* The [[Iki Town festival tournament]] ends
* Gladion leaves and reveals that his goal is to defeat the [[Ultra Beast]]s.
* The next day, Sun awakens on a boat with the island challenge amulet, where he meets the {{adv|Rotom Pokédex}}.
{{Adventuresevents}}
{{endspoilers}}
